## Vignettes

<div
  id="vignette-filters"
  class="vignette-filters"
  role="group"
  aria-label="Filter vignettes by audience level"
></div>

<div id="vignette-cards" class="fims-card-grid vignette-grid" aria-live="polite">
  <p>Loading vignettes…</p>
</div>

```{=html}
<script type="module">
  const levelInfo = {
    "new-user": {
      label: "New User",
      className: "level-new-user"
    },
    "intermediate-user": {
      label: "Intermediate User",
      className: "level-intermediate-user"
    },
    "contributor": {
      label: "Contributor",
      className: "level-contributor"
    }
  };

  const levelOrder = {
    "new-user": 1,
    "intermediate-user": 2,
    "contributor": 3
  };

  let allVignettes = [];
  let currentFilter = "all";

  function renderVignettes(vignettes, filter = "all") {
    const container = document.getElementById("vignette-cards");
    if (!container) return;

    const filtered = filter === "all"
      ? vignettes
      : vignettes.filter(v => (v.level || "new-user").toLowerCase() === filter);

    container.textContent = "";

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.textContent = "No vignettes found for this filter.";
      container.appendChild(p);
      return;
    }

    filtered.forEach(v => {
      const rawLevel = (v.level || "new-user").toLowerCase();
      const level = levelInfo[rawLevel] || {
        label: rawLevel.replace(/[-_]/g, " "),
        className: "level-default"
      };

      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = `fims-card vignette-card position-relative ${level.className}`;

      const strip = document.createElement("div");
      strip.className = "vignette-level-strip";

      const badge = document.createElement("div");
      badge.className = "vignette-level-badge";
      badge.textContent = level.label;

      const title = document.createElement("h3");
      title.textContent = v.title || "Untitled vignette";

      const summary = document.createElement("p");
      summary.textContent = v.summary || "";

      const footer = document.createElement("div");
      footer.className = "fims-card-footer";

      const link = document.createElement("a");
      const pageUrl = v.page || "#";
      // Validate external link protocol to adhere to security instructions
      if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(pageUrl) || pageUrl.startsWith("/") || pageUrl.startsWith("#")) {
        link.href = pageUrl;
      } else {
        link.href = "#";
      }
      link.className = "fims-btn-full stretched-link";
      link.setAttribute("aria-label", `Go to the ${v.title || "vignette"} vignette`);
      link.target = "_blank";
      link.rel = "noopener";

      const linkText = document.createTextNode("Read vignette ");
      const icon = document.createElement("i");
      icon.className = "bi bi-arrow-right";
      icon.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      link.append(linkText, icon);
      footer.appendChild(link);
      card.append(strip, badge, title, summary, footer);
      container.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function setupFilterButtons(vignettes) {
    const filtersContainer = document.getElementById("vignette-filters");
    if (!filtersContainer) return;

    filtersContainer.textContent = "";

    const counts = { all: vignettes.length };
    vignettes.forEach(v => {
      const rawLevel = (v.level || "new-user").toLowerCase();
      counts[rawLevel] = (counts[rawLevel] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const filterOptions = [
      { id: "all", label: "All" },
      { id: "new-user", label: "New User" },
      { id: "intermediate-user", label: "Intermediate User" },
      { id: "contributor", label: "Contributor" }
    ];

    filterOptions.forEach(opt => {
      const count = counts[opt.id] || 0;
      if (opt.id !== "all" && count === 0) return;

      const btn = document.createElement("button");
      btn.type = "button";
      btn.className = `vignette-filter-btn ${opt.id === currentFilter ? "active" : ""}`;
      btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", opt.id === currentFilter ? "true" : "false");
      btn.dataset.filter = opt.id;

      const labelSpan = document.createElement("span");
      labelSpan.textContent = opt.label;

      const countSpan = document.createElement("span");
      countSpan.className = "vignette-filter-count";
      countSpan.textContent = String(count);

      btn.append(labelSpan, countSpan);

      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        currentFilter = opt.id;
        const allButtons = filtersContainer.querySelectorAll(".vignette-filter-btn");
        allButtons.forEach(b => {
          const isActive = b.dataset.filter === currentFilter;
          b.classList.toggle("active", isActive);
          b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", isActive ? "true" : "false");
        });
        renderVignettes(allVignettes, currentFilter);
      });

      filtersContainer.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  async function loadVignetteCards() {
    const container = document.getElementById("vignette-cards");
    const endpoint = "https://e-perl-noaa.github.io/FIMS/vignettes.json";

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch vignette metadata: ${res.status}`);

      const data = await res.json();
      allVignettes = Object.values(data).sort((a, b) => {
        const levelA = (a.level || "new-user").toLowerCase();
        const levelB = (b.level || "new-user").toLowerCase();
        return (levelOrder[levelA] || 99) - (levelOrder[levelB] || 99);
      });

      if (!Array.isArray(allVignettes) || allVignettes.length === 0) {
        container.textContent = "";
        const p = document.createElement("p");
        p.textContent = "No vignettes found.";
        container.appendChild(p);
        return;
      }

      setupFilterButtons(allVignettes);
      renderVignettes(allVignettes, currentFilter);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      container.textContent = "";
      const p = document.createElement("p");
      p.textContent = "Could not load vignettes.";
      container.appendChild(p);
    }
  }

  loadVignetteCards();
</script>
```
